newsitem.title: USA: NPC sees negative factors continuing in Q3.
newsitem.headline: NPC sees negative factors continuing in Q3.

text.p: NPC International Inc, a restaurant operator, said it expects to be adversely impacted by increased commodity prices and negative comparable sales throughout the fiscal third quarter before any potential relief may be realized in the fourth quarter.

NPC said its second quarter results were hurt by a 20 percent increase in cheese costs as compared with the same quarter a year ago, as well as negative comparable store sales in its Pizza Hut division.
Earlier, NPC reported earnings for the second quarter ended September 24 of $0.16 a share, up from $0.15.
